raw_segments.text: Anything approaching the change that came over his features I have never seen before,
and hope never to see again.
It was as though a veil had been rent.
I saw on that ivory face the expression of somber pride, of ruthless power, of craven
terror, of an intense and hopeless despair.
Did he live his life again in every detail of desire, temptation, and surrender during
that supreme moment of complete knowledge?
He cried in a whisper at some image, at some vision.
He cried out twice, a cry that was no more than a breath.
